People on the coast or along rivers in areas under a warning should immediately evacuate to high ground or evacuation buildings.
The estimated arrival time is the time when the tsunami arrives earliest within the forecast area. In some places the tsunami may arrive considerably later than this time.
It may take several hours or more from the estimated arrival time until the tsunami reaches its maximum height, so regardless of the observed tsunami height, do not leave the safe place until the warning is cancelled.
